hypothesis: The causal implied-vol term slope of the OTHER underlying (cross-asset term_slope spillover) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward realized return kurtosis (fourth standardized moment) of the target underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + alignment floor.
extends: EVAL-74 (_term_bars term_slope signal verbatim) + EVAL-117 (forward realized return kurtosis target verbatim) + EVAL-122/114 (cross-asset spillover path) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed); distinct cell: cross-asset term_slope spillover -> forward realized return kurtosis

cross_section.spillover_signal: signal_k = term_slope[OTHER](k)  (other asset's causal near-minus-far ATM IV term slope)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term slope of the OTHER underlying (e74._term_bars term_slope), aligned to the common BTC-vs-ETH bar grid (build_cross_section), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return kurtosis = m4 / m2**2 over the TARGET underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]); fourth standardized moment, transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-117
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(other_term_slope_z_k, own_kurt_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (wider other-asset near-minus-far ATM IV slope -> fatter forward return tails on the target)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades with iv/strike/expiry + perp candles); no new acquisition, no network

Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
